Part Name: Hitachi OEM Main Control Valve Block Assembly
Description: Precision hydraulic manifold block assembly with solenoid valves, pressure relief valves, and high-pressure ports. Manages oil distribution to boom, arm, bucket, and swing circuits for Zaxis-7 excavators.

Part Name: Hitachi OEM Dual Axial Piston Main Hydraulic Pump
Description: Dual variable-displacement axial piston hydraulic pump assembly (HPV118DW series). Generates high-pressure hydraulic flow up to 380 bar with electronic flow regulator.

Part Name: Hitachi OEM Stage V Industrial Diesel Engine Assembly
Description: Complete Stage V emission-compliant 6-cylinder turbocharged common-rail industrial diesel engine assembly. High torque output and optimized fuel economy for heavy earthmoving.

Part Name: Hitachi OEM Slewing Ring / Swing Bearing Assembly
Description: Massive precision machined steel slewing ring gear assembly with internal gear teeth and induction-hardened raceways. Connects upperstructure to lower frame under heavy load.

Part Name: Hitachi OEM Final Drive Travel Motor & Gearbox
Description: Integrated axial piston travel motor with multi-stage planetary gear reduction box. Provides high tractive torque and dual-speed travel for crawler excavator undercarriages.

Part Name: Hitachi OEM Electronic Control Module (ECM / Main Controller)
Component / Assembly: Main ECM Unit (installed in Cab / Upperstructure)
Description: Heavy aluminum heatsink sealed main engine and machine control unit with multi-pin waterproof Deutsch harness connectors. Runs Z-7 control software and ConSite telematics processing.

Part Name: Hitachi OEM Multi-Station Solenoid Valve Manifold Bank
Description: Precision machined electro-hydraulic solenoid valve block with 24V gold-plated coils and auxiliary pilot control lines. Regulates pilot signal pressures for boom, arm, and hydraulic quick coupler.

Part Name: Hitachi OEM Forged Dual-Flange Lower Track Roller Assembly
Component / Assembly: Lower Track Roller (installed in Track Frame)
Description: Forged alloy steel dual-flange track roller with induction-hardened tread surfaces and lifetime duo-cone seals. Supports excavator machine weight across crawler track links.

Part Name: Hitachi OEM Heavy Hydraulic Demolition Breaker Attachment
Description: Heavy hydraulic rock and concrete demolition hammer featuring noise-dampened orange housing, forged steel chisel tool bit, and high-impact energy cell.

Part Name: Hitachi OEM ZW-Series Heavy Wheel Loader Axle Assembly
Description: Heavy-duty front drive axle with internal torque-proportioning differential and wet multi-disc brake system. Engineered for high breakout force on ZW wheel loaders.

Part Name: Hitachi OEM High-Intensity LED Working Light Bar Kit (24V)
Component / Assembly: LED Light Group (installed on Cab & Boom)
Description: Rugged black aluminum housing light bar with 100W high-output LED array and stainless mounting bracket. Provides illumination for night operation in quarry and construction sites. Stated applicability: All Zaxis excavators and ZW wheel loaders.

Part Name: Hitachi OEM Heavy-Duty 24V Engine Starter Motor Assembly
Description: High-torque 24V 7.0kW industrial starter motor assembly with heavy cast nose and sealed solenoid. Designed for quick cold-weather engine starts on Zaxis-7 excavators. Stated applicability: ZX200-7 to ZX390-7.
Brushless heavy-duty 24V 100A alternator with internal voltage regulator and heavy cooling fins. Dust and moisture sealed for harsh quarry environments. Stated applicability: ZX200-7 to ZX390-7.

Part Name: Hitachi OEM Dual-Core Radiator & Hydraulic Oil Cooler Module
Description: High-efficiency aluminum dual-core cooling radiator and hydraulic oil cooler module. Dissipates thermal load under heavy excavation work. Stated applicability: ZX210LC-7 to ZX350LC-7.

Part Name: Hitachi OEM Heavy-Dust Air Breather & Pre-Cleaner Assembly
Description: Heavy-duty composite canister air cleaner housing featuring centrifugal pre-cleaner top and dual filter elements. Extends engine life in dusty demolition and mining applications. Stated applicability: ZX210LC-7 to ZX350LC-7.

Part Name: Hitachi OEM Single-Flange Upper Carrier Roller Assembly
Component / Assembly: Carrier Roller (installed on Upper Track Frame)
Description: Single-flange top carrier roller with heat-treated tread surface, central shaft, and heavy mounting bracket. Supports track sag on crawler excavators. Stated applicability: ZX210LC-7 to ZX350LC-7.

Part Name: Hitachi OEM Induction-Hardened Track Drive Sprocket Segment Group
Component / Assembly: Drive Sprocket Segment (installed on Final Drive Hub)
Description: Forged alloy steel drive sprocket segment with deep induction-hardened drive teeth. Transmits propulsion force from final drive to track links. Stated applicability: ZX210LC-7 to ZX350LC-7.
